basic_info.description: Welcome to a residence of elegance and comfort, located in the heart of St. Francis Wood.This exceptional property offers the perfect blend of classic charm and modern luxury, ideally designed for discerning buyers seeking an impeccably curated home.  This light filled home features a gracious living room with wood-burning fireplace and a sleek wet bar, a central hall floor plan, beautiful formal dining room, striking remodeled custom kitchen offering top-of-the-line stainless steel appliances, custom cabinetry and exquisite finishes, separate laundry room, 3 spacious bedrooms including and ensuite primary, plus a bright office or nursery, huge media room addition with fireplace and full bath on main level opens onto your outdoor oasis with a stunning architect designed redwood deck leading you to the bright southwest lush terraced yard. Interior access brings you to a rebuilt spacious 1 car garage with extra storage. Stroll to nearby West Portal Village  to enjoy the vibrant shops, restaurants, and amenities of this charming neighborhood, a short distance to public transportation with EZ access to freeways.
